meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 启动后,Claude 会宣布“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,当队长组建 5 人敌对评审团;成员互相攻击观点,只保留经受住攻击的内容,再交给专门规划器做成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“adversarial plan”等关键词,或要求对计划做最严格审查(如暴露薄弱假设、盲点、过度设计)时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 来规划这个功能上线方案。
启动 hpp,帮我审查当前计划中的假设和盲点。
用 adversarial plan 模式做个计划,挑出过度设计。

howto.what_en: On activation, Claude announces "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", leads a 5-member hostile team attacking each other's findings. Only insights surviving attacks are kept and handed to a planner (ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or asks for maximum-rigor planning review.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this feature rollout.
Start hpp and audit my current plan's assumptions and blind spots.
Make a plan in adversarial plan mode, flag over-engineering.
